map.废液铬回收率 使用指南: Spent-Liquor Chrome Recovery Rate — User Guide
map.输入制革废液的处理前后铬浓度与处理量，计算铬回收率与回收铬量，帮助评估废液处理效: Enter pre/post-treatment chrome concentrations and treatment volume of tannery effluent to compute chrome recovery rate and amount—assessing treatment effect and resource recovery, supporting cleaner production and environmental compliance.
map.按处理前后废液铬浓度差计算回收率，评估铬回收工艺效果。: Compute recovery rate from the chrome concentration difference before/after treatment; assess recovery-process effectiveness.
map.按处理量与浓度差算出回收的铬质量，用于资源化收益与减排核算。: From treatment volume and concentration difference, compute recovered chrome mass for resource-value and emission-reduction accounting.
map.对比不同回收工艺（沉淀、吸附、膜分离）的处理效率。: Compare different recovery processes (precipitation, adsorption, membrane) on efficiency.
map.：铬回收率(%) = (废液浓度 − 回收后浓度) ÷ 废液浓度 × 100%；: : chrome recovery rate (%) = (raw − post concentration) ÷ raw concentration × 100%; recovered chrome (kg) = (raw − post) × volume (L) ÷ 1,000,000 (mg/L). Grades: ≥90% excellent, ≥75% good, ≥50% fair, else poor. If post concentration exceeds raw, the tool caps it at no higher than the original.

map.回收率和吸收率有什么区别？: What's the difference between recovery and absorption rate?
map.吸收率看鞣制工序中皮吸收了多少铬（减少用量与排放），回收率看末端治理从废液中回收: Absorption rate looks at how much chrome the hide absorbs in tanning (less use and emission); recovery rate looks at how much chrome is reclaimed from effluent at end-of-pipe—the former is cleaner production, the latter end-of-pipe resource recovery.
map.技术上越高越有利于减排与资源回收，但需权衡药剂与能耗成本；应结合处理成本与排放标: Technically higher is better for emission cuts and recovery, but weigh reagent and energy cost; set an economically feasible target against treatment cost and discharge standards.
